PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_Risk
PropertySetDef.Definition:
Definition from buildingSMART International: An indication of exposure to mischance, peril, menace, hazard or loss.
There are various types of risk that may be encountered and there may be several instances of Pset_Risk associated in an instance of an IfcObject (either a physical object, a grouping of physical objects such as an asset or a process).

PropertyDef.Name: RiskType
PropertyDef.Definition: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

PropertyDef.Name: NatureOfRisk
PropertyDef.Definition:
An indication of the nature of the risk that might be encountered.
NOTE: It is anticipated that there will be a local agreement that constrains the values that might be assigned to this property.

PropertyDef.Name: AssessmentOfRisk
PropertyDef.Definition:
A value that is assigned to the risk that is assessed in a given situation.
NOTE: It is anticipated that there will be a local agreement that constrains the values and meanings that may be assigned to this property. The data type is enabled as an IfcLabel to account for alpha, numerical and alphanumerical assessment ratings.
Note also that assessment of risk may frequently be associated with the physical location of the object for which the risk is assessed.
